content: # CyclogenAI FAQ

question: How do I create an account
content: Visit the signup page and enter your name, email, and password. After signing up, you'll be prompted to complete your onboarding — set your cycling experience, goals, FTP, weight, and other profile details. You can also connect Strava during onboarding.
heading: How do I create an account

question: How do I log in
content: Go to the login page and enter your email and password. If you used Google OAuth during signup, use the Google sign-in button instead.
heading: How do I log in

question: I forgot my password. What do I do
content: Click "Forgot Password" on the login page. Enter your email and you'll receive a reset link. Click the link in the email to set a new password. After resetting, you'll be automatically logged in and redirected to the dashboard.
heading: I forgot my password. What do I do

question: How do I set up my profile after signing up
content: Go to Settings > Profile. You can update your name, FTP, weight, height, max heart rate, age, and cycling experience. Your FTP is especially important for accurate zone calculations and training plan recommendations.
heading: How do I set up my profile after signing up

question: What is FTP and why does it matter
content: FTP (Functional Threshold Power) is the highest power you can sustain for approximately one hour. It's the cornerstone of power-based training. All your power zones, workout intensities, and training load calculations are based on your FTP. Keep it updated as you get fitter.
heading: What is FTP and why does it matter

question: Where is the dashboard
content: The dashboard is the first page you see after logging in. It shows your weekly summary, recent activities, heatmap, training readiness, and quick stats. You can access it anytime by clicking the logo or "Dashboard" in the sidebar.
heading: Where is the dashboard

question: How do I navigate the app
content: Use the sidebar on the left. The main sections are: Dashboard, Activities, Calendar, Training, Gear, Strava settings, and Account settings. On mobile, the sidebar collapses into a hamburger menu.
heading: How do I navigate the app

question: What does each sidebar item do
content:
- Dashboard: Your home screen with weekly stats, recent rides, heatmap, goal progress
- Activities: Full list of all your rides with search, filter, and detail views
- Calendar: Monthly view of your activities and planned workouts
- Training: Weekly training plan, AI coaching, and performance analysis
- Gear: Manage your bikes and equipment
- Strava: Connect/disconnect Strava, manage sync settings
- Settings: Profile, password, notifications, preferences
heading: What does each sidebar item do

question: Where do I see my weekly statistics
content: The weekly statistics graph and summary are on the Dashboard. It shows performed activities vs planned workouts for the current and past weeks. You can zoom in/out to see more weeks.
heading: Where do I see my weekly statistics

question: What does the heatmap show
content: The heatmap on the dashboard shows all your activities as colored lines on a map. Warmer colors (orange/red) indicate higher intensity. Click any activity line to view its details.
heading: What does the heatmap show

question: How do I connect Strava
content: Go to Settings > Strava and click "Connect Strava." You'll be redirected to Strava's authorization page. Approve the requested permissions, and you'll be redirected back. Your activities will sync automatically.
heading: How do I connect Strava

question: What data does CyclogenAI sync from Strava
content: We sync all cycling activities (rides, virtual rides, e-bike rides) including distance, duration, elevation, power data, heart rate, cadence, speed, temperature, and route/stream data. Non-cycling activities are not synced.
heading: What data does CyclogenAI sync from Strava

question: How often does auto-sync run
content: Auto-sync checks for new activities every 30 minutes by default. You can adjust this in Settings > Strava or manually trigger a sync anytime.
heading: How often does auto-sync run

question: How do I manually sync
content: In Settings > Strava, click "Sync Now" to pull the latest activities. You can also ask the chatbot: "Sync my Strava" or "Run a sync."
heading: How do I manually sync

question: How do I disconnect Strava
content: In Settings > Strava, click "Disconnect Strava." This revokes CyclogenAI's access to your Strava account. Your existing data remains in CyclogenAI but no new activities will sync.
heading: How do I disconnect Strava

question: Why is my sync stuck or failing
content:
Common causes: Strava API rate limits (429 errors), expired tokens, or network issues. Try the following:
1. Go to Settings > Strava and check the sync status
2. Click "Sync Now" to retry
3. If the token is expired, disconnect and reconnect Strava
4. Wait a few minutes — Strava rate limits reset hourly
5. Contact support if the issue persists
heading: Why is my sync stuck or failing

question: How do I check sync status
content: Ask the chatbot "What's my sync status?" or go to Settings > Strava. The status shows when your last sync was, whether you're up to date, and any rate limit issues.
heading: How do I check sync status

question: What is Strava rate limiting
content: Strava limits API requests to 100 requests every 15 minutes and 1000 requests per day. If you have many activities, a full sync may take several rounds. The system handles this automatically and resumes when the limit resets.
heading: What is Strava rate limiting

question: How do I generate a training plan
content:
You can generate a plan in two ways:
1. On the Training page, click "Generate Plan" or use the AI planning tool
2. Ask the chatbot: "Generate a training plan for this week" or "Plan my week"
The AI will consider your fitness level, recent training load, goals, and available time.
heading: How do I generate a training plan

question: What types of workouts can the AI create
content: The AI can create: Endurance rides, Tempo workouts, Sweet Spot sessions, Threshold intervals, VO2max intervals, Sprint workouts, Recovery rides, and Pre-race taper blocks. Each workout includes duration, intensity zones, and structure.
heading: What types of workouts can the AI create

question: How do I view my current weekly plan
content: Ask the chatbot "What's my plan for this week?" or go to the Training page. The plan shows each day's workout type, duration, and intensity.
heading: How do I view my current weekly plan

question: Can I modify a generated plan
content: Yes. You can tell the chatbot "Change Wednesday's workout to endurance" or "Make Saturday's ride 3 hours instead of 2." You can also manually edit the plan on the Training page.
heading: Can I modify a generated plan

question: How does the AI determine my training load
content: The AI uses your recent activity history (last 3-4 weeks), CTL (Chronic Training Load), ATL (Acute Training Load), and TSB (Training Stress Balance). It adjusts intensity and volume to avoid overtraining while ensuring progressive overload.
heading: How does the AI determine my training load

question: What is progressive overload
content: Progressive overload means gradually increasing training stress (volume, intensity, or frequency) over time to drive fitness gains. The AI plans typically increase load by 5-10% per week, with recovery weeks every 3-4 weeks.
heading: What is progressive overload

question: How do I set a weekly distance goal
content: Click "Set Weekly Goal" on the Dashboard's weekly statistics section, or ask the chatbot "Set my weekly goal to 150km." The goal is saved in your browser and reset manually.
heading: How do I set a weekly distance goal

question: Where can I see all my activities
content: Go to the Activities page from the sidebar. It shows a sortable, filterable list of all your rides. You can search by name, filter by date range, or sort by distance, duration, or date.
heading: Where can I see all my activities

question: How do I view activity details
content: Click any activity in the list or on the heatmap. The detail page shows: map with route, power/heartrate/cadence graphs, splits, elevation profile, weather, gear used, and AI analysis.
heading: How do I view activity details

question: What is AI activity analysis
content: For each activity, the AI generates an analysis covering: workout type classification, performance metrics, fatigue patterns, pacing assessment, and recommendations for future training. Look for the analysis section on the activity detail page.
heading: What is AI activity analysis

question: How do I find a specific activity
content: Use the search bar on the Activities page. You can search by name, or use the date filters to narrow down. You can also ask the chatbot "Find my ride from last Tuesday."
heading: How do I find a specific activity

question: Can I delete an activity
content: Currently, activities synced from Strava cannot be deleted from CyclogenAI. They are removed automatically if deleted on Strava after the next sync.
heading: Can I delete an activity

question: How do I add a bike
content: Go to Gear from the sidebar and click "Add Bike." Enter the bike name (e.g., "Trek Emonda") and optionally set it as active. Bikes synced from Strava appear automatically.
heading: How do I add a bike

question: How do I set a bike as active
content: On the Gear page, click the "Set Active" button on the bike you want. The active bike is used for distance tracking and appears on activity detail pages. You can also ask the chatbot "Set my active bike to [name]."
heading: How do I set a bike as active

question: How do I add other equipment
content: On the Gear page, switch to the "Equipment" tab and click "Add Equipment." Enter the name and type (e.g., "Garmin 530" — Computer). Equipment is for your reference and tracking.
heading: How do I add other equipment

question: My Strava bikes don't appear in CyclogenAI
content: Run a manual sync from Settings > Strava. Bikes are synced from Strava during the sync process. If they still don't appear, try disconnecting and reconnecting Strava.
heading: My Strava bikes don't appear in CyclogenAI

question: How is gear distance tracked
content: When you complete a ride with a Strava bike, the distance is automatically added to that bike's total. You can see total distance per bike on the Gear page.
heading: How is gear distance tracked

question: How do I open the chatbot
content: Click the orange circular button at the bottom-right corner of any page. It has a chat icon.
heading: How do I open the chatbot

question: What can I ask the chatbot
content:
You can ask about:
- Your training: "How was my last ride?", "What's my plan this week?"
- Generating plans: "Plan my week", "Create a workout for tomorrow"
- Zones: "What are my power zones?", "Calculate zones from 280 FTP"
- Strava: "Sync my Strava", "What's my sync status?", "Connect Strava"
- Gear: "List my bikes", "Add a bike called Canyon Aeroad", "Set active bike"
- General help: "How do I connect Strava?", "Where is the settings page?", "How do I generate a training plan?"
- Activity analysis: "Analyze my ride from yesterday", "How was my weekend ride?"
heading: What can I ask the chatbot

question: What commands does the chatbot support
content:
The chatbot understands natural language. Some common command examples:
- "/week" — Opens the weekly training plan
- "Sync Strava" — Triggers a manual sync
- "My power zones" — Shows your FTP-based zones
- "Set my weekly goal to 200km"
- "Add a bike called [name]"
- "List all my bikes"
heading: What commands does the chatbot support

question: Why is the chatbot giving short answers
content: The chatbot is designed to be concise. It answers directly without greetings or padding. If you need more detail, ask a follow-up question like "Tell me more about that" or "Give me the full analysis."
heading: Why is the chatbot giving short answers

question: Can the chatbot remember previous conversations
content: Yes. The chatbot remembers the context of your current conversation (last ~30 messages). It also has access to your training history, fitness profile, and any notes the AI coach has saved about you.
heading: Can the chatbot remember previous conversations

question: How do I change my password
content: Go to Settings > Account > Change Password. Enter your current password and the new password. The change-password page uses the orange theme matching the rest of the app.
heading: How do I change my password

question: How do I update my fitness profile
content: Go to Settings > Profile. You can update: FTP, weight, height, max heart rate, age, cycling experience, and training goals. These values are used by the AI coach for plan generation and analysis.
heading: How do I update my fitness profile

question: How do I change my notification preferences
content: Go to Settings > Notifications. You can enable/disable email notifications for: new activity analysis, weekly training plan ready, sync completed, and account updates.
heading: How do I change my notification preferences

question: Can I delete my account
content: Account deletion is not currently available from the app. Contact support if you need your account removed.
heading: Can I delete my account

question: The app shows old data or activities are missing
content:
Try these steps in order:
1. Go to Settings > Strava and click "Sync Now"
2. Check that Strava is connected (reconnect if needed)
3. Check that the activities are cycling activities (other sports are not synced)
4. Wait for the sync to complete (large syncs may take time due to rate limits)
heading: The app shows old data or activities are missing

question: The activity detail page won't open
content:
If clicking an activity shows a blank page or error:
1. Refresh the page
2. Try opening from a different location (heatmap vs. activity list)
3. Clear your browser cache and reload
4. If the URL shows "undefined" in the path, report this as a bug
heading: The activity detail page won't open

question: The weekly graph shows no data
content:
If the weekly statistics graph is empty:
1. Ensure you have synced activities for the current week
2. Try changing the zoom level
3. Check that your training start date is set correctly in Settings
4. The graph requires at least one activity to show
heading: The weekly graph shows no data

question: The onboarding screen keeps showing
content:
This can happen if your browser clears localStorage. To prevent this:
1. Complete onboarding fully (all steps)
2. The system now checks multiple sources (localStorage, backend, database)
3. If it still shows, contact support
heading: The onboarding screen keeps showing

question: The chatbot is not responding
content:
If the chatbot doesn't reply:
1. Check your internet connection
2. Refresh the page and try again
3. The backend may be starting up — wait a moment
4. If using a VPN, try disabling it
5. Contact support if the issue persists
heading: The chatbot is not responding

question: I see "401 Unauthorized" errors
content: This usually means your session expired. Log out and log back in. If the issue continues, clear your browser cache and cookies.
heading: I see "401 Unauthorized" errors

question: The forgot password email didn't arrive
content:
1. Check your spam/junk folder
2. Ensure you entered the correct email address
3. Wait a few minutes — email delivery can be delayed
4. Contact support if you still don't receive it
heading: The forgot password email didn't arrive

question: How do I report a bug or get help
content: For bugs and support requests, report the issue at the project repository or contact the development team through the support channel.
heading: How do I report a bug or get help

question: What browsers are supported
content: CyclogenAI supports the latest versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. Internet Explorer is not supported.
heading: What browsers are supported

question: Is there a mobile app
content: CyclogenAI is a web application that works on mobile browsers. There is no native mobile app currently.
heading: Is there a mobile app
